systemctl --version | sed -n '1p'

command:
set -eu
sudo install -d -m 0700 /etc/cryptsetup-keys.d
sudo sh -c 'umask 077; dd if=/dev/urandom of=/etc/cryptsetup-keys.d/secure_volume.key bs=64 count=1 status=none'
sudo truncate -s 512M /var/lib/secure-volume.img
sudo chmod 0600 /var/lib/secure-volume.img
sudo cryptsetup luksFormat --type luks2 --batch-mode --key-file /etc/cryptsetup-keys.d/secure_volume.key /var/lib/secure-volume.img
sudo cryptsetup isLuks /var/lib/secure-volume.img
printf '%s\n' 'Created LUKS2 container and node-local key file.'

command:
set -eu
sudo cryptsetup open --key-file /etc/cryptsetup-keys.d/secure_volume.key /var/lib/secure-volume.img secure_volume
sudo mkfs.ext4 -q -L secure_data /dev/mapper/secure_volume
sudo install -d -m 0750 /srv/secure
sudo mount /dev/mapper/secure_volume /srv/secure
sudo sh -c 'printf "%s\n" "encrypted-volume-persistent-data" > /srv/secure/restart-proof.txt'
sudo chmod 0640 /srv/secure/restart-proof.txt
sudo sync
printf 'TYPE=%s LABEL=%s\n' "$(sudo blkid -s TYPE -o value /dev/mapper/secure_volume)" "$(sudo blkid -s LABEL -o value /dev/mapper/secure_volume)"
findmnt /srv/secure
